register_trace_logging_service: register a TraceLoggingService instance in the TraceLoggingRegistry with a custom key
get_trace_logger: get a trace logger from TraceLoggingRegistry by key or use the default SimpleTraceLoggingService
register_instance_run_id: register an instance ID to run ID mapping in the InstanceIdtoRunIdRegistry
get_run_id: get a run ID from InstanceIdtoRunIdRegistry by key or generate a default UUID-based ID
override_default_registry: override the default value in any RegistryFactory subclass using override_default
